messages:
Grace L: Pager: embeddings-service (eu-west1) latency spike and 5xx increase. Seeing 95p jump from ~300ms -> 2s+, errors climbing ~1.8% -> 8%. I'm on outbound call in ~10m, handing off.

incident-bot: [PAGER] SEV=2 embeddings-service/eu-west1 - High p95 latency and error rate. Links: https://dashboards.redwood/embeddings/eu-west1, logs: https://logs.redwood/q=service:embeddings

Devon S: I'll take driver. Oncall window active for next 6h. Grace, any in-flight mitigation already?

Grace L: Thanks @Devon. I'm running a rolling restart of the inference pods to clear a stuck worker group (started 30s ago). Noticed a surge of OOMs in one node pool.

Priya K: I'll own comms. Drafting message for #statuspage after we confirm customer impact. Need brief: impacted region, ETA to mitigation, workaround.

Akash M: I'll dig into autoscaler config and node metrics. Possible noisy tenant causing KV cache churn. Checking per-tenant request rates.

Devon S: Grace - confirm the rolling restart command you used? paste?

Grace L: Running: ``kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/embeddings-eu-west1 --context=cluster-eu-west1``. Doing one pod at a time. If p95 drops after a pod comes back healthy I'll hold.

Devon S: Copy. Watching pods: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep embeddings` shows 3/6 restarting.

Akash M: I see one pod with repeated OOMKill entries in syslogs (container runtime). Also node memory pressure around 83%. Autoscaler hasn't spun up due to pod anti-affinity. Opening a quick patch to relax anti-affinity if restarts don't help.

Devon S: Reassigning roles: Devon = driver (making decisions), Priya = comms, Akash = infra lead (autoscale/node issues), Grace = outgoing owner/subject matter expert. If anyone else needs to jump in ping.

Priya K: Draft for statuspage: "We are investigating increased latency and errors in embeddings (eu-west1). Some requests may be delayed or erroring. On-call team is actively mitigating; next update in 15m." Approve?

Grace L: LGTM. Add note: "Mitigation: rolling restart in progress; potential short-term increase in errors during pod restarts."

Devon S: Observability: p95 dropped from 2.1s -> 1.0s after the 4th pod restart, errors back down to ~2.4%. Still above baseline but improving. Akash, any change on node pool?

Akash M: Started temporary nodepool scale-up: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-eu-embeddings --size=6`. Also creating a taint-based buffer so critical pods can schedule. If scaling succeeds, we can set anti-affinity back.

Priya K: Posting to #statuspage now. Tagging support leads.

Priya K (posted): "Update: rolling restarts in progress; partial service recovery observed. Customers in eu-west1 may experience intermittent latency/errors. Next update in 15m. (Devon S driving, Akash M infra)." :loud_sound:

Devon S: If p95 holds under 1.2s for two consecutive 5m windows, we'll mark incident as mitigated and continue to monitor. If errors >5% again, escalate to oncall-sre.

Grace L: One more handoff note: I'm about to log off (flight) in ~8m. Leaving runbook pointers: /runbooks/embeddings-latency (pages 2-3 for rolling restarts), playbook snippet: `if OOMs -> scale nodepool, relax anti-affinity, restart one pod at a time`.

Devon S: Thanks Grace. Safe travels. Grace, please post any remaining notes in the thread before you go.

Grace L: Posted short runbook excerpt and which pod index had the OOMs. Also noted the tenant id that spiked traffic (tenant: research-lab-71).

Akash M: Nodepool resize succeeded, new nodes registered, pods are distributing. I'll watch for KV cache churn metrics and consider an eviction threshold increase if needed.

Priya K: New customer impact check: we have 12 distinct customer API keys with elevated 5xx counts; top 3 account for ~70% of the increased load. Flagging account owners.

Devon S: Good context. Plan: continue monitoring; if p95 stays <1.2s and errors <3% for 10m, transition to recovery status. Priya keep on status updates. Akash document nodepool changes for postmortem. Grace, thanks for handoff.

Grace L: Thanks team, I'm off now.

Devon S: Acknowledged — driver now. I'll keep thread updates and call shortrun bridge if we regress.

incident-bot: Incident note added: mitigated=false, in_progress=true, owner=Devon S, comms=Priya K

Devon S: (10m later) p95 steady at ~1.1s, errors 2.6%. I'll declare 'mitigating' and set follow-up 1hr postmortem. Closing active pager for now but keeping monitoring.

Priya K: Posted update to #statuspage with mitigation details and ETA for postmortem. Will consolidate logs and tenant list for postmortem doc.

Akash M: Leaving a runbook note: revert anti-affinity change after stable state, do not reduce nodepool below prev capacity for 24h.

Devon S: End of thread notes: Owner handoff confirmed (Grace -> Devon), comms owner Priya, infra lead Akash. Follow-up: 1hr postmortem + runbook updates.
